ammonia.reason: Extensive deamination by yeasts and Brevibacterium linens deacidifies surface pH 5 to 7-8.35 releasing NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Red-smear coryneforms produce isovaleric acids plus p-cresol/indole-type barnyard notes.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic rennet peptides present but trimmed by smear peptidases and masked by 1.79% NaCl.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; 2-heptanone only 32-49 ug/kg, no blue methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Free amino acids plus residual galactose drive Maillard on heating, aided by orange smear pigments.

buttery.reason: Moderate diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by mesophilic starters, partly masked by smear sulfur acids.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Extremely high butanoic acid 474-2360 ppm plus 3-methylbutanoic 497-1980 ppm and hexanoic from lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 30% fat in demineralized proteolyzed uncooked paste gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Deacidified Ca-solubilized cohesive washed-rind paste, not acid-crumbly.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~41.8% uncooked rennet gel with soft surface-ripened paste gives low resistance.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol only qualitative in smear cheeses, no absolute accumulation for Munster.

fruity.reason: Low esterification; ethyl hexanoate 0 control to 244 ug/kg, fruity subordinate to acids and sulfur.

goaty.reason: 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic not detected in cow-milk Munster; only faint caprine sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Leu/Ile/Val Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal 43-95, 2-methylbutanal, 2-methylpropanal by smear coryneforms.

melt.reason: Deacidified pH ~6.5 solubilized Ca-phosphate uncooked curd flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/one not quantified for Munster; Geotrichum mushroom faint versus smear sulfur.

oil_off.reason: 30% fat with extensive lipolysis coalesces to free oil when melted.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and guaiacol not found; no pyrolysis phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Very high acetic acid 1248-1921 ppm from heterofermentative metabolism persists despite deacidification.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; rennet gel with no aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: L-methionine gamma-lyase in B. linens yields methanethiol 62-159, DMDS 1262-3235, DMS and DMTS.

sweet.reason: Lactose exhausted by 27d; faint sweet from glycerol/amino acids overwhelmed by salt and acid.

umami.reason: Rennet plus smear proteolysis liberates Glu and kokumi peptides in 3-4 week paste.
